subject: Pilot: inference demo — prospect reprioritizes to infrastructure sprint
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@anthos.ai>, Carlos Mendez <carlos@anthos.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff & proposed demo times

Hi Laura / Carlos —

Great to meet on Friday — thanks again for the intro. Per our call, I put together a short agenda and two proposed demo slots next week so your team can see inference throughput and latency on a sample dataset:

- Demo agenda (20–30m): quick context, live inference run, perf/scale Q&A, next steps
- Proposed times: Tue 22 Jun 2026 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 23 Jun 2026 15:00–15:30 PT

I've attached a short deck that highlights our Dedicated and Private options and included a one-page note on typical rollout timelines (deck-anthos-inference-demo.pdf). If those times don't work, tell me a couple windows that do and we will accommodate.

Also cc'ing Marissa (CS) and Dev (Solutions Eng) so they can prep a short checklist for security & sample data needs if we move forward.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: deck-anthos-inference-demo.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); sprint-plan-excerpt.txt (TXT, excerpt)

From: laura.chen@anthos.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@anthos.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff & proposed demo times

Jonas —

Quick update from our side: we've had an internal roadmap reset this morning. The platform/infra team just got bumped to the top of the PI for Q3 (migration to a new core ML platform + central data lake), and leadership asked us to pause all adjacent pilot work that isn't tied to that migration. That includes the inference pilot we discussed.

There are a few practical reasons: key engineers are being reallocated to the migration, our SREs will be fully booked for the next 6 weeks, and the execs want a consolidated integration approach before we do any third-party inference pilots.

Can we put the demo on hold for now? Preferably we pause scheduling and revisit in ~8–10 weeks after the first migration sprint. We appreciate the materials you shared — please keep them on file and we may ask for a shorter technical session later in July/August.

I'll loop back once we've stabilized. Apologies for the short notice — this came through as part of today's leadership sync.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of ML Programs | Anthos AI
laura.chen@anthos.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura.chen@anthos.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff & proposed demo times

Laura —

Totally understand and thanks for letting us know so quickly. We'll pause active scheduling and mark this opportunity as 'nurture' in our pipeline. A few quick notes / offers while you're heads-down on the migration:

- If it's helpful, we can provide a short one-pager on how Redwood's Dedicated mode integrates with central ML platforms (ops/ingestion patterns, KV cache considerations) — that might help your Platform lead argue for piloting later.
- We can also line up a 15-minute technical office hour with Dev to answer any architecture questions your infra team has (no demo, just Q&A).
- We'll leave the deck and a brief decision checklist in the shared drive link above; if you want any compliance artifacts (SOC2 excerpts, data-retention options) I can get those from Marissa.

Would you be comfortable if we check back on Aug 3 for a short sync? If a different date works better, tell us and we'll respect your internal cadence.

Appreciate the heads up — we'll be ready when you are.

Thanks —
Jonas

Attachments referenced: deck-anthos-inference-demo.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff & proposed demo times — internal note

Jonas / Dev —

Logging the pause in SF CRM and tagging as 'roadmap-reprioritized' per Laura's note. I'll add the SOC2 excerpt and retention summary to the Drive folder so it's ready if Anthos asks during the migration.

Suggested follow-up: Aug 3 check-in with a lightweight agenda (15m) — confirm infra capacity and whether a 15–20m architecture office hour would be more useful than a demo. If Anthos prefers to remain hands-off, we can set a 90-day nurture reminder and move to cadence 1x/month.

I'll close the loop in CRM and draft the nurture task.

—Marissa
